turns.doctor_question: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
turns.patient_response: Well, student health actually sent me here. I'm trying to get cleared to help out with these youth workshops, but they told me my weight is too low to sign off on it. They said the number on the scale has just kept dropping. I mean, I guess it has, but to me it just feels like... what happens when I’m focused and really busy with my classes, you know?

symptom_reasoning.S044: The patient acknowledges being sent by student health due to significantly low weight and confirms that the number on the scale has continued to drop.

turns.doctor_question: Are you afraid of gaining weight or becoming heavier?
turns.patient_response: Yes. Honestly, even the idea of gaining a single pound makes me panic. It's just... if I were to sit down and eat a normal dinner, or have something with butter in it, I feel like everyone would immediately be able to see that I’ve lost my discipline. So, yes, the thought of getting heavier really scares me.

symptom_reasoning.S045: The patient explicitly confirms an intense fear and panic at the thought of gaining weight or becoming heavier.

turns.doctor_question: Have you had episodes where you felt unable to control yourself while eating an unusually large amount of food?
turns.patient_response: No, not at all. I don't really... I don't ever eat large amounts of food. It's kind of the opposite for me. I keep very strict control over everything I eat, so I've never had a time where I felt out of control like that.

symptom_reasoning.S049: The patient explicitly states they never eat large amounts of food.
symptom_reasoning.S050: The patient explicitly denies ever experiencing a loss of control while eating, stating they keep strict control and have never felt out of control.

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any way to purge or compensate after eating, such as making yourself vomit or misusing laxatives, diuretics, or enemas?
turns.patient_response: No, I haven't done anything like that. I don't make myself throw up or use laxatives or anything. Like I said, I just... I control what I eat in the first place, so I don't need to do any of those things.

symptom_reasoning.S048: The patient explicitly denies engaging in purging behaviors, specifically stating they do not make themselves throw up or use laxatives.
